chinese: 我们不应该做出任意的决定
english: We should not make arbitrary decisions

chinese: 当问题出现时我们需要评估风险
english: When problems arise we need to assess the risk
soundmark: /wen ˈprɒbləmz əˈraɪz wiː niːd tuː əˈses ðə rɪsk/

chinese: 他断言这个假设是正确的
english: He asserted that the assumption was correct
soundmark: /hiː əˈsɜːrtɪd ðæt ðə əˈsʌmpʃən wɒz kəˈrekt/

chinese: 老师把任务分配给了每个学生
english: The teacher assigned tasks to every student
soundmark: /ðə ˈtiːtʃər əˈsaɪnd tɑːsks tuː ˈevri ˈstjuːdənt/

english: I can assure you that we will assist you in completing this project
soundmark: /aɪ kæn əˈʃʊər juː ðæt wiː wɪl əˈsɪst juː ɪn kəmˈpliːtɪŋ ðɪs ˈprɒdʒekt/

english: This event gave rise to an array of problems and aroused public concern
